scripts.build: pnpm --filter @mandate-court/schemas build && pnpm --filter @mandate-court/sdk build && pnpm --filter @mandate-court/cli build && pnpm --filter @mandate-court/web build
scripts.test:genlayer: uvx --from genvm-linter genvm-lint check contracts/genlayer/mandate_adjudicator.py && uvx --offline --from genlayer-test gltest contracts/genlayer/tests/direct -v -s
scripts.test:studionet: uvx --from genvm-linter genvm-lint schema contracts/genlayer/mandate_adjudicator.py --json | jq '.schema' > contracts/genlayer/mandate_adjudicator.schema.json && uvx --from genlayer-test gltest contracts/genlayer/tests/integration -v -s --network studionet
scripts.validate: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
